children: Kothari Industrial Corporation Limited (KICL), from D.C. Kothari group, has announced its entry into the FMCG sector through the launch of its fresh beverage portfolio ‘Chusip’ Coco Twist, a coconut water drink.

The sugarless natural tender coconut water will be available in 200 ml packs priced at ₹50 with a 1-litre pack to be introduced soon. The company also plans to introduce other drink flavours including fruit drinks.

“Our research finding shows there is a trend emerging in India of consumers moving towards healthy, natural and authentic choices. We strongly believe this is the right time to bring back the purity of nature in the form of coconut water sourced from the finest coconut farms,” said Jinnah Rafiq Ahamed, Executive Director, KICL.

The company said in a media release that it intends to build a ₹2,500 crore beverage business by 2035 by strengthening its presence in South India with over 100 distributors across Tamil Nadu, Kerala and Karnataka.

title: Kothari Group enters FMCG sector with new coconut water drink
